expected_output.reason: Spam marketing blog. 99% win rate is statistically impossible (high_performance_ratio_mirage anti-pattern). Forex (not futures — wrong asset class for Trading Forge). MetaTrader (not the Trading Forge engine). Subscription pitch with countdown timer = scam pattern. No entry rule, no exit rule, no parameters extractable. Reject and do not re-route — this is junk.

notes: Hard-reject example.
